title: Editor Media And Utility Node Readiness Checklist

items.label: Capture Project Control, terminology, Editor roadmap, and owner repository context before implementation.
items.evidenceTarget: Project Control entrypoint, product terminology, Editor AGENTS.md, and old Editor roadmap Task 8 are reviewed before implementation.
items.verificationNote: Identified Work path flowdoc-product-development-resumption > flowdoc-core-backend-editor-readiness-pass-8h, owner repository repo-editor, phase target phase-flowdoc-core-backend-editor-readiness-pass-editor-media-utility-node-readiness, checklist target checklist-flowdoc-core-backend-editor-readiness-pass-editor-media-utility-node-readiness, and evidence target evidence-editor-media-utility-node-readiness-2026-08-31 before record edits.

items.label: Write failing Editor and Project Control tests before accepting media and utility readiness.
items.evidenceTarget: Utility readiness matrix, blocked unsupported contracts, hidden visible actions, utility Paper markup, and Project Control registration fail before implementation or record edits.
items.verificationNote: RED evidence included utilityNodeReadiness failing because the module did not exist, addNodeContract failing because unsupported contracts still used the older Core-only reason, addNodeVisibleActions requiring unsupported media/utility buttons to remain absent, and Project Control Work Queue failing because this phase was not registered.

items.label: Classify media and utility readiness from Core placement facts and Backend operation capabilities.
items.evidenceTarget: image, page-break, spacer, divider, and toc expose status, contractStatus, coreContainerStatus, backendOperationKind, backendOperationStatus, and reason facts.
items.verificationNote: utilityNodeReadiness tests prove the matrix contains image, page-break, spacer, divider, and toc facts derived from Core placement and Backend mutationOperations for the active package/document pair.

items.label: Keep unsupported media and utility add-node contracts blocked before Backend requests can be used.
items.evidenceTarget: Unsupported media/utility contracts return null requests and exact Core/Backend blocked reasons.
items.verificationNote: addNodeContract tests prove page-break remains blocked with request null and the exact Core/Backend insert operation reason. Related readiness facts keep image blocked by Core container rules and page-break/spacer/divider/toc blocked by contract support.

items.label: Do not create visible add buttons for unsupported media or utility operations.
items.evidenceTarget: Visible Outline add actions do not serialize image.insert, page-break.insert, spacer.insert, divider.insert, or toc.insert.
items.verificationNote: addNodeVisibleActions tests prove unsupported media and utility operation kinds are not exposed as visible add buttons while Text and Columns readiness remains independently gated.

items.label: Mark utility Paper preview surfaces without adding editing controls.
items.evidenceTarget: Utility Paper markup exposes data-utility-node-kind and data-utility-node-readiness=blocked while omitting textarea and contenteditable controls.
items.verificationNote: PaperBlock tests prove page-break preview markup exposes blocked readiness facts and does not introduce textarea or contenteditable authoring controls.

items.label: Run Editor worktree and merged-main gates, record Project Control evidence, and keep maps unchanged.
items.evidenceTarget: Focused Editor tests, full Editor check, no-write live Backend smoke, and Project Control record tests support the bounded evidence record.
items.verificationNote: Editor worktree and merged main passed focused 10-file/50-test gate, npm run check with 106 test files and 385 tests plus build, and FLOWDOC_EVIDENCE_WRITE=0 npm run evidence:editor-browser-live-backend-smoke. Project Control records are added without map promotion.
